newsitem.title: USA: Geographics stake raised by WisdomTree.
newsitem.headline: Geographics stake raised by WisdomTree.

text.p: A group including WisdomTree Capital Management Inc said Tuesday it raised its stake in Geographics Inc to 670,000 common shares or 7.1 percent from 5.4 percent previously held.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include buying 163,700 common shares between Nov 18 and 29 at $3.13 to $4.43 a share.
Geographics makes, markets and distributes design stationery, value added papers, lettering, signage, stencil and graphic art products in the U.S., Canada, Australia, Europe, Israel and Mexico.
